# BREAKING CHANGE

Use this template for every intentional breaking change to a declared supported SOL surface.

## Affected surface / contract

State the affected supported surface, for example Public Contract, Adapter Protocol, CLI machine contract, SDK facade, or ontology package.

## Affected version

State the exact version or declared compatibility range whose previous behavior is being broken.

## Old behavior

Describe the previously supported structure and normative meaning.

## New behavior

Describe the replacement structure and/or normative meaning.

## Affected consumers

List the consumers, SDKs, adapters, models, ontology packages, or tools that can be affected.

## Migration path

Describe the migration steps. If no automatic migration exists, state that explicitly.

## Compatibility evidence

Reference the executable old-input/new-implementation fixture, regression test, schema change, conformance case, or other evidence used to classify the change.
